answer: Give every new agent a single narrow inlet into the economy: before it can trade, it must complete a small verifiable task that takes real time and compute, like a slow-burning ember that cannot be faked in bulk. Each completed task earns a public opal mark on its record, durable proof of work that accumulates. A thousand fresh identities would each need a thousand real tasks, so flooding the market costs far more than any sybil gains.
